title: Maury Island incident: slag rains onto a boat

tellings.quote: guy sitting in a boat in Puet Sound and what appear to be UFOs of some kind are flying overhead and one of them appears to be in distress and it rains like shards of metal or slag or something all over his his boat,

plain: A researcher named Peter Levenda describes on Jesse Michels's podcast a 1947 story in which a man sitting in a boat in Puget Sound, in Washington state, saw what seemed to be several UFOs flying overhead. According to Levenda, one of them appeared to be in trouble and showered shards of metal or slag over the boat, with a man named Fred Crisman linked to the tale. If true, it would mean physical debris fell from an unknown craft.
